description: Header file defining the class 'phy_metrics_ulsch_demultiplex_decorator', which is a decorator for UL-SCH demultiplexer metrics, including methods for demultiplexing, resource usage measurement, and metrics notification.

classes.name: phy_metrics_ulsch_demultiplex_decorator
classes.description: A decorator class for UL-SCH demultiplexer that adds metrics collection and resource usage measurement.

methods.name: set_csi_part2
methods.description: Sets the CSI part 2 buffer and its encoding parameters.

methods.name: demultiplex
methods.description: Performs demultiplexing of the input buffers while measuring resource usage and timing.

methods.name: get_next_block_view
methods.description: Returns the next block view of log-likelihood ratios from the base buffer.

methods.name: on_new_block
methods.description: Processes a new block of data, updates resource usage metrics.

methods.name: on_end_codeword
methods.description: Finalizes the current codeword, updates metrics, and notifies the metrics collector.
